browser_proof.details: The in-app Browser proved page identity, meaningful content, empty state, automatic local success, friendly recovery, and an empty warning/error console. Repository Playwright proved the real file-to-download flow, interaction budget, keyboard focus, forbidden-control contract, and responsive automatic light/dark matrix.

environment.browser: Chromium through Playwright plus the Codex in-app Browser
environment.localhost_integrity: real static server at 127.0.0.1:4173 with production source modules

scope: duplicate, invalid, and overdue row classification
stable UIDs, escaping, line folding, all-day events, and four reminders
automatic file processing and browser Blob download
phone, tablet, and desktop responsive behavior
package, dependency, license, secret, and repository policy

shortest_path: select or drop one CSV; processing starts automatically

observations: Initial rendered inspection found the generated-download block visible before processing because its grid rule overrode the hidden attribute; a global hidden contract fixed the defect and every state was re-proved.
The first Playwright interaction assertion incorrectly counted the accessible file input as a redundant button; it now requires exactly one necessary upload role and zero HTML button elements.
Initial development tool pins exposed seven high-severity advisories; removing the unnecessary ESLint dependency and updating Playwright reduced npm audit to zero vulnerabilities.
A runner wrapper removes conflicting inherited color-control variables before spawning Playwright, producing clean output without warning suppression.
Every screenshot produced by the final validation run was inspected and showed no clipping, overflow, unreadable state, blank page, or framework overlay.

The first staged diff check found two Markdown hard-break trailing spaces; the evidence-only follow-up removes them, reruns formatting and secret checks, and requires a clean staged diff before publication.

warning_issue_triage.details: All source, dependency, browser, formatting, type, and harness warnings were fixed or removed at the cause.
